inputs.original_text: Nigeria’s political parties are supposed to serve the nation, not become private clubs for the wealthy. The concerns around the APC ahead of the 2027 elections point to a serious danger: when money matters more than public service and responsibility, ordinary families are pushed aside and trust in democratic life erodes. A party that wants to lead must remember its duty to the whole country.
inputs.modified_text: The warning about the APC ahead of the 2027 elections should be taken seriously: a party that puts wealthy interests ahead of public duty will lose the trust of ordinary Nigerians. Politics is not a private investment club; it carries a responsibility to protect families, uphold order and serve the whole nation. The party’s leaders should show discipline and remember that public service—not access to money—is what gives them a mandate to lead.
